text.what: Co-director of the Domaine de la Romanée-Conti from 1974 to 2021, and the man who spent a decade carrying Burgundy's climats to UNESCO.
text.story: He ran the domaine alongside Lalou Bize-Leroy until disagreements ended that arrangement in 1991, stepped back to an advisory role in 2022, and chaired the campaign that put the climats on the World Heritage List in 2015.

kin.as: The domaine he ran for nearly fifty years.
The unit he argued was heritage.
